title: Advanced Paste cannot discover Foundry Local 0.10.x models

judgment.rationale: The reporter provides a complete Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 reproduction and a diagnostic showing an empty service URL. Current provider initialization depends on legacy Endpoint/ServiceUri accessors before catalog calls, a concrete compatibility boundary.
evidence: Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 is running and the CLI responds.
The diagnostic reports an empty service URL and invalid absolute-URI behavior.
FoundryClient.GetServiceUrl/GetServiceUri expose manager properties and FoundryLocalModelProvider.InitializeAsync consumes them before listing models.
No linked upstream fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve the fork-side endpoint discovery design with explicit SDK-version compatibility and actionable diagnostics.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current endpoint accessor contract appears incompatible with Foundry Local 0.10.x; a provider-side compatibility adapter is supportable.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve Foundry Local 0.10.x endpoint reliably
proposed_fixes.root_cause: FoundryLocalModelProvider assumes FoundryClient's legacy manager Endpoint/ServiceUri values are populated, but Foundry Local 0.10.x can expose a running service through a different discovery contract, leaving the URI empty.
plan: Identify the supported 0.10.x endpoint accessor and normalize it to an absolute base URI.
Centralize endpoint validation in FoundryClient; reject empty or non-absolute values with a diagnostic that names the discovery state.
Use the normalized URI consistently for catalog, cached-model, and chat-client requests.
Retain compatibility with older SDKs and add mocked tests for endpoint-present, endpoint-empty, and alternate-accessor cases.
verification: Reproduce with PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 and Foundry Local 0.10.3.0.
Confirm phi-4-mini is listed and Advanced Paste can create a client.
Retest an older supported Foundry Local version and service-not-running failure.

confidence.rationale: The empty URI is direct evidence and the endpoint wrapper is localized, but the exact 0.10.x SDK accessor must be confirmed during implementation.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste cannot discover a model from Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 even though the Foundry CLI server is usable.
information_gaps: Exact SDK endpoint accessor and URI path semantics.

design.root_cause: Provider initialization receives no usable absolute URI from the current Foundry manager wrapper.

implementation_steps.change: Resolve and normalize the 0.10.x endpoint, validate absolute URI, and expose one source of truth.
implementation_steps.code_shape: var endpoint = manager.NewEndpoint ?? manager.Endpoint ?? manager.ServiceUri; return NormalizeAbsolute(endpoint);
tests: Mock each accessor and assert normalized URI/error.

implementation_steps.change: Use the validated URI for all requests and surface discovery failure without pretending no models exist.
implementation_steps.code_shape: var uri = await client.GetRequiredServiceUriAsync(); await client.ListCachedModels(uri);

verify: Build Advanced Paste/common provider targets using existing repository workflow.
Run the reported Foundry Local reproduction and older-version compatibility checks.
risks: Incorrect path normalization could break older versions.
alternatives: Hard-code localhost:5272: rejected because the service port and path are deployment-specific.
Treat empty URI as no models: rejected because it hides a discovery failure.

fork_trace.note: Fork-only design mirror; no upstream action implied.

adversarial_review.conclusion: No blocking objections; confirm the exact 0.10.x SDK contract and preserve older versions.
non_blocking_notes: Keep endpoint errors distinct from empty catalog results.
